vsl.title: Another way to express ourselves. Another chance to understand.
vsl.body: A conversation can begin with movements of the hands, eye contact and facial expressions. Exploring VSL gives hearing people a chance to enter those conversations with initiative and respect.

beginning.title: We want to understand one another. But where do we begin?
beginning.one.title: Finding a clear learning source
beginning.one.body: With materials scattered across different sources, beginners need to know what to learn first and where to go next.
beginning.two.title: From watching to trying

story.title: A wish to connect. A beginning for SignHearing.
story.one: We are building SignHearing as an approachable starting point for hearing people who want to learn VSL.
story.two: The project aims to organise learning materials by topic, helping learners watch sample videos and practise step by step. An AI feedback tool is being developed to support practice within a limited set of signs.
story.three: Each step in development needs to go hand in hand with reviewing content, listening to feedback and being clear about what the product can actually do.

features.faq.eyebrow: A few useful things to know
features.faq.title: Before you begin.
features.faq.body: Short answers, grounded in how the current build works.
features.faq.account.q: Do I need to create an account?
features.faq.account.a: No. The current prototype opens directly and has no sign-in or account sync. You can explore its tools without registering.
features.faq.camera.q: Does the camera record or upload my image?
features.faq.camera.a: No. The camera starts only after your action, requests video without audio and works as a mirror. Turn it off at any time or use a physical mirror. Camera access requires localhost or HTTPS.
features.faq.ai.q: Can AI grade my signs yet?
features.faq.ai.a: Not yet. You assess the practice checklist yourself; quiz scores reflect recognition answers only. There is no AI feedback or movement-accuracy score.
features.faq.progress.a: In the Supabase database, linked to your account. Sign in with the same account on another device to restore progress.
features.faq.video.q: Why do some signs have no video?
features.faq.video.a: The two sample lessons have no approved videos. The separate collection of 12 imported clips is available in Dictionary and Self-practice, but is unreviewed and not assigned to the curriculum. Official learning materials are still being prepared.
features.faq.language.q: Does switching to English change the sign language?
features.faq.language.a: No. VI/EN changes the interface language only. The subject remains Vietnamese Sign Language; translations for the imported clip collection are provisional.

settings.language.title: Interface language
settings.language.note: Choose a language for the interface. Switching languages keeps your saved progress.
settings.data.title: Your data
settings.data.note: Progress is saved to your Supabase account. Clearing browser data does not delete progress already saved on the server.
settings.storage.unavailable: This browser cannot save data. Progress is currently held only in the page's memory and may be lost on reload or when the page closes. Download a JSON file to keep a copy.
settings.export.success: Sent signhearing-tien-do.json to your browser for download.
settings.export.error: Could not create the data file. Try again or check your browser's download settings.
settings.confirm.title: Delete learning data in this browser?
settings.confirm.note: This removes lesson states, signs viewed, practice sessions, quiz results and favourites. It cannot be undone on this page. Download the JSON file first if you want to keep a copy.
settings.delete.success: Progress and favourites deleted. Lessons are back to Not started.
settings.nojs: Enable JavaScript to view the summary, download or delete data saved in this browser. You can still change languages and read the information on this page.
settings.camera.title: Camera
settings.camera.note: The camera is a practice mirror. It starts when you choose and stops when you leave the session. No video or audio is recorded, and no images are sent.
settings.camera.permission.granted: Camera permission: Allowed. The camera is not active on the settings page.
settings.camera.permission.denied: Camera permission: Blocked. You can change this using the steps below.
settings.camera.permission.prompt: Camera permission: Not decided. Your browser will ask when you select Turn on camera during self-practice.
settings.camera.permission.unknown: Camera permission status is unavailable in this browser. You can still check permission using the icon beside the address.
settings.camera.help.title: Allow camera access in Chrome / Edge
settings.camera.help.open: Select the padlock or site permissions icon beside this site's address.
settings.camera.help.allow: Open Camera (or Site settings → Camera), then select Allow.
settings.camera.help.return: Return to self-practice, reload if your browser asks, then select Turn on camera. You can also practise using a physical mirror without enabling the camera.
settings.about.title: About & limitations
settings.about.role: SignHearing supports self-study of Vietnamese Sign Language. It does not replace a teacher or an interpreter.
settings.about.materials: Learning content is organised around the VSL 400 path.
settings.about.ai: This version has no AI sign recognition or scoring. Practice results are your own assessment.
settings.about.sample: Content marked Sample is used to experience the interface.
